commands: try { $page=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $url -Headers $headers -TimeoutSec 30; Write-Host ('WIKI_TITLE=' + $page.title); Write-Host ('BODY_LEN=' + $page.body.Length); Write-Host '=== BODY SAMPLE ==='; Write-Host $page.body.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(6000,$page.body.Length)); $page.body | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 .agent/sex-wiki-body.txt } catch { Write-Host ('WIKI_FETCH_ERROR=' + $_.Exception.Message); exit 2 }

$matches=[regex]::Matches($page.body,'\[\[([^\]|#]+)'); $tags=@($matches | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -and $_ -notmatch '^wiki:' } | Sort-Object -Unique); Write-Host ('WIKI_LINK_TAGS=' + $tags.Count); $tags | Select-Object -First 120 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('TAG=' + $_) }

$py=@'
import sqlite3,sys
path=sys.argv[1]
tags=sys.argv[2:]
con=sqlite3.connect(path)
missing=[]
for tag in tags:
    raw=tag.replace(' ','_')
    row=con.execute('select raw,category,count from tags where raw=?',(raw,)).fetchone()
    if not row: missing.append(tag)
print('DB_WIKI_HITS='+str(len(tags)-len(missing)))
print('DB_WIKI_MISSING='+str(len(missing)))
for x in missing[:120]: print('MISSING='+x)
for q in ['sex','vaginal','oral','anal','penetration','cum','fellatio','cunnilingus']:
    rows=con.execute("select raw,category,count from tags where raw like ? order by count desc limit 12",('%'+q+'%',)).fetchall()
    print('QUERY='+q+' => '+str(rows))
con.close()
'@; $pyPath=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'nai_check_sex.py'; Set-Content -Path $pyPath -Value $py -Encoding UTF8; & python $pyPath $tmp @tags; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item $tmp,$pyPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code
